prompt: The video begins with a first-person perspective moving steadily forward through a dark, forested path at night in Le Prarion, Chamonix-Mont-Blanc, France. The camera advances slowly, capturing the silhouettes of tall trees lining both sides of the narrow trail, their outlines barely discernible against the dimly lit sky. As the viewer progresses, the faint glow of starlight filters through the dense canopy above, casting subtle shadows that dance across the uneven terrain. The camera angle remains steady, focused straight ahead, providing a continuous view of the path as it winds gently through the woods. Gradually, the scene transitions from the forest into an open area where a rustic wooden cabin comes into view, its structure faintly illuminated by the ambient light. The camera continues to move forward, passing the cabin and revealing a vast expanse of open land stretching towards distant mountains. The sky above is dotted with countless stars, forming a breathtaking celestial display. The camera then pans upwards, capturing the full splendor of the Milky Way as it arches across the night sky, its luminous band standing out vividly against the dark backdrop. The scene concludes with a momentary pause, allowing the viewer to fully absorb the serene beauty of the star-filled heavens before fading to black. Throughout the video, the environment remains empty and tranquil, with no other individuals or movement disrupting the peaceful solitude of the night.
